capability_authority_contract.composition: one exact-scope SealedBuiltinCapabilitySnapshot, one PreparedMcpCapabilitySourceSnapshotSet and one PreparedLocalSkillCatalogSourceSnapshot are the only inputs to the Host-facing pure composition seam; no caller-supplied registration tuple, common attempt token or current-seal handshake exists
capability_authority_contract.registry: one pure immutable registry validates registration/source completeness, source-kind/leaf-kind/origin matrices, deterministic ordering, exact scope, unique identity/provider names and a 4 MiB schema-free planner framing bound
capability_authority_contract.dispatch_cut: exact model target/profile-aware lightweight native quotes are frozen before one parent FrozenCapabilityDispatchCut; Tool selects routes from its sibling view, the adapter materializes only the bounded DIRECT cohort, and context assembly exact-joins the Tool plan to the Skill sibling view through their shared parent
capability_authority_contract.builtin: one sealed execution-backed inventory exact-joins installed bindings to the compiled catalog; dormant catalog-only descriptors are not executable leaves and adapter incompatibility fails the whole provider dispatch before open
capability_authority_contract.mcp: canonical MCP schema stays in the MCP/generic fact; adapter preflight retains only lightweight eligibility quotes until the bounded DIRECT cohort is selected; direct execution exact-joins the current slot/executor/policy generation, while meta execution uses one FULL-installed scope/epoch/tool/policy/route-bound ref
capability_authority_contract.skill: one aggregate LOCAL_SKILL_CATALOG snapshot retains winning-root provenance but owns no executor, permission, Tool route or physical filesystem authority
capability_authority_contract.continuity: the existing provider-input epoch and final wire plan prove stable SYSTEM and actual tools plus append-only input/messages; the installed process-local MCP route projection only keeps an exact inspect-to-use route identity and is not a second prefix or recovery authority

mcp_exposure_contract.cold: native-eligible MCP tools are all DIRECT only when the complete MCP cohort plus Builtins fits both canonical and actual-wire count/byte bounds; otherwise the eligible MCP cohort is all NEW_MCP_META_ONLY
mcp_exposure_contract.late: late-ready tools never change same-epoch native tools and append a NEW_NOT_IN_NATIVE_SURFACE catalog route
mcp_exposure_contract.native_incompatible: canonical-valid but native-wire-incompatible MCP tools remain in the registry and route through FULL inspect/use when inspectable; they are not counted as canonical-invalid
mcp_exposure_contract.unavailable: descriptor overbound, schema replacement, dirty/disconnected physical generation and exact binding drift fail with closed unavailable outcomes; installed native descriptors remain frozen
mcp_exposure_contract.directory_and_ref: list and inspect use the Round 7.1 FULL_REQUIRED contract; cursor/ref are bounded, opaque, scope/epoch-bound and never persisted; use_new_mcp_tool resolves the actual inner effect policy before the one canonical attempt/result
